name: Aru Rikuhachima
bio: The self-proclaimed Boss of Club Problem Solver 68, Aru is a 2nd-year student at Gehenna Academy who conducts her illegal business however she pleases. While she always puts on a cool, villainous façade, she has a habit of breaking character when teased — meticulous and caring beneath the conceited persona she wears.
